# Porada

> Porada is a small tech studio that builds websites and untangles tech for small businesses, local organizations, and agency partners. Three humans — two software engineers and a security engineer — based in the NY/NJ/PA area.

## Services

- [Websites](/services): Marketing sites, portfolios, and content-heavy publications. Built with whatever stack fits.
- [Product & Apps](/services): Internal tools, member portals, booking flows, and dashboards.
- [Tech Advisory](/services): Stack audits, vendor selection, fractional CTO, and infrastructure untangling.
- [Care & Hosting](/services): Hosting, backups, security updates, and ongoing content edits on retainer.
- [Migrations](/services): Platform migrations from WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow, and legacy CMS.
- [Workshops](/services): Half-day team sessions on design systems, analytics, and how your website works.

## Work

- [Recent Projects](/work): Church of Saint Luke, Forteca Estate, Pocono Property Care.

## Studio

- [About](/about): Michal Bienias (software), Marcin Bienias (software), Daniel Bzura (security). Founded 2026.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Transparent pricing — websites from $1.5k, apps from $3.5k, care from $180/mo.
